rules.name: cash-refresh-01-preflight-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT table_schema,table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema IN ('opera','opera_backup_04_10') AND (table_name IN ('deal_ticket_table','cloned_deal_ticket_table','security_info_table','cloned_security_info_table','premium_fy_table','rms_premium_paid_table','deal_active_lots_table','fixing_table','netting_id_table','security_settlement_value_table','security_last_actual_value_table','underlying_settle_value_table','underlying_actual_value_table','futures_price_table','client_master_data','client_threshold_master','client_cash_account_balance_table','client_account_cash_balance_fixing_table','product_master_table','underlying_list_table','financial_year_table') OR table_name IN ('valuation_date_table','vdate_sdate_table')) ORDER BY table_schema,table_name,ordinal_position

SELECT 'current' AS snapshot,business_unit,value_date,settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(business_unit)='CFS' UNION ALL SELECT 'backup',business_unit,value_date,settlement_date FROM opera_backup_04_10.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(business_unit)='CFS'

SELECT 'current' AS snapshot,value_date,settlement_date FROM opera.vdate_sdate_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND value_date IN (SELECT settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND business_unit='CFS') UNION ALL SELECT 'backup',value_date,settlement_date FROM opera_backup_04_10.vdate_sdate_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND value_date IN (SELECT settlement_date FROM opera_backup_04_10.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND business_unit='CFS')

SELECT cob_date,count(*) AS n_rows,count(DISTINCT client_code) AS n_clients FROM opera_backup_04_10.client_cash_account_balance_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND business_unit='CFS' GROUP BY cob_date ORDER BY cob_date DESC
SELECT business_unit,count(*) AS n_rows FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))='CFS' GROUP BY business_unit

SELECT cob_date,count(*) AS n_rows,count(DISTINCT client_code) AS n_clients FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND business_unit='CFS' GROUP BY cob_date ORDER BY cob_date DESC
SELECT business_unit,count(*) AS n_rows FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))='CFS' GROUP BY business_unit

SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments, pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS definition FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='opera' AND p.proname='fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope'
